title: catapodium rigescens
intro: Catapodium rigescens, commonly known as Rock Whitlow Grass or Rock Whitlow Grass is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It is a small, perennial grass that grows in rocky areas and is native to the Mediterranean region. Catapodium rigescens is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is said to help with respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
